title: 5 Lahan Krutadnyatechya Goshti (Part 1)
subtitle: Beautiful Marathi moral stories for kids
description: Give your child the gift of good values with this beautiful collection of 5 short gratitude stories in Marathi. Each story is crafted to teach children the importance of being thankful and content. Perfect for bedtime reading and early moral development. Includes engaging illustrations to keep kids interested. (Part 1 of the Gratitude Series)
